Called meeting of City Council
Austin Tex Jan. 26th 1870

The Mayor in the chair. Aldermen present: Wm Brueggerhoff, F. Dohme, N. B. Mitchell, J. H.
Robinson, and S. H. Todd.
No quorum being present, Council adjourned to the first Monday in February
Fred Sterling
Recorder

Regular Meeting of City Council
Austin Tex Feb 3rd 1870

Mayor J. B. Wheeler presiding; present Alder men G. S. Boardman, Wm Brueggerhoff, Ed.
Christian, F. Dohme, N. B. Mitchell, J. H.
Robinson and S. H. Todd. Absent Ald. [illegible] On motion the reading of the Minutes were
dispensed with.
The report from the Judges of the special election held on the seventh day of [illegible]
for an Alderman of the seventh Ward, was read, showing that T. A. Ben nent received six
votes and S. Piper sixty-three votes. The report was received and adopted.
On motion, S. Piper was declared Alderman elect for the seventh Ward, and sworn into
office and seated.
The report from the Judges of the special election held for an Alderman of the first Ward,
on the 22nd day of January 1870, was read, showing that O. H. Cullen received twenty-five
votes, James Simms twenty-four votes and J. A. Hash fifteen votes.
A protest from J. Simmons, proposing to contest the election of O. H. Cullen before the
Board of Aldermen, was then read, whereupon Alder Brueggerhoff moved that the report from
the
